    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.

    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x

   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl

   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv

   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2

   138	    rw [← heq]

   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=

   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)

   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl

   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi

   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/

   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm

   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv

   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=

    93	/-! ## Piecewise line-bundle trivializations -/
    94	
    95	/-- Sections of the native module over one cocycle piece are the structure-ring sections.
    96	
    97	The open-immersion ring equivalence transports the component trivialization from the ambient
    98	relative curve to the restricted scheme.  The `gluedTriv_gluedQsmul` identity is exactly the
    99	structure-sheaf semilinearity needed for this to be a linear equivalence over the restricted
   100	ring of sections. -/
   101	noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv
   102	    (j : D.index) (V : (D.pieces j).toScheme.Opens) :
   103	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) ≃ₗ[
   104	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) := by
   105	  let e := gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
   106	  let ρ := ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   107	  let f : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) →ₗ[
   108	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) :=
   109	    { toFun := fun s => ρ (e s)
   110	      map_add' := by
   111	        intro s t
   112	        change ρ (e (s + t)) = ρ (e s) + ρ (e t)
   113	        change ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t)) =
   114	          ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s) +
   115	            ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t)
   116	        rw [show gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t) =
   117	            gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s +
   118	              gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t by
   119	              exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).map_add s t]
   120	        exact ρ.map_add _ _
   121	      map_smul' := by
   122	        intro r s
   123	        change ρ
   124	            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
   125	              (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl) (ρ.symm r) s)) =
   126	          r * ρ
   127	            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s)
   128	        rw [gluedTriv_gluedQsmul]
   129	        simp [ρ] }
   130	  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective f
   131	  constructor
   132	  · intro s t h
   133	    have h' := congrArg ρ.symm h
   134	    dsimp [f] at h'
   135	    rw [ρ.symm_apply_apply, ρ.symm_apply_apply] at h'
   136	    exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).injective h'
   137	  · intro r
   138	    refine ⟨e.symm (ρ.symm r), ?_⟩
   139	    change ρ (e (e.symm (ρ.symm r))) = r
   140	    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, ρ.apply_symm_apply]

   142	/-- The piecewise section equivalences assemble to a sheaf isomorphism with the unit module. -/
   143	noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSheafIso (j : D.index) :
   144	    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D) ≅

   151	        apply LinearMap.ext
   152	        intro x
   153	        change
   154	          ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso W.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   155	              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le W.unop)
   156	                (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
   157	                  ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop)) x)) =
   158	            (D.pieces j).toScheme.presheaf.map f
   159	              (((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   160	                (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x))
   161	        rw [gluedTriv_res B D.isGluingCocycle j
   162	          ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
   163	          ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x]

   169	                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x) =

   171	              ((D.pieces j).ι.opensFunctor.map f.unop).op

   176	/-- The canonical native module is locally a free rank-one structure-sheaf module. -/
   177	theorem nativeModule_isLineBundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle (nativeModule D) := by
   178	  intro x
   179	  let j := D.pieceIndex x
   180	  refine ⟨D.pieces j, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x, ?_⟩
   181	  exact ⟨nativeModulePieceSheafIso D j⟩
   182	
   183	/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
   184	the datum's original module of sections.
   185	
   186	The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
   187	point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
   188	of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
   189	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
   190	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
   191	    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   192	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
   193	      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
   194	  let f :
   195	      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   196	        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
   197	        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
   198	    { toFun := fun x => x
   199	      map_add' := by
   200	        intros
   201	        rfl
   202	      map_smul' := by
   203	        intro r x
   204	        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
   205	            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
   206	          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
   207	        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
   208	          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
   209	  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩
   210	
   211	/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.
   212	
   213	This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
   214	presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
   215	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
   216	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   217	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
   218	  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
   219	    (NatIso.ofComponents
   220	      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
   221	      (fun {_ _} _ => by
   222	        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   223	        apply LinearMap.ext
   224	        intro x
   225	        rfl))

    36	/-- **Pointwise chart-colength fibre vanishing from ideal-fibre span.**  Let `B` be the
    37	pinned-chart section ring, `J` the genuine `B`-ideal generated by the readings of `K`, and
    38	`I = (read s)` for `s ∈ K`.  If every vector of
    39	`κ(p) ⊗[B] J` is a scalar multiple of `1 ⊗ read(s)`, then the image of `J` in `B/I` has
    40	zero `κ(p)`-fibre.  This is the exact single-point input consumed by the `κ(z)` RD-N bridge;
    41	it uses no global base-fibre or flatness inference. -/
    42	theorem subsingleton_chartIdealColengthModule_tensor_residueField_of_ideal_span
    43	    (K : Submodule R (relThetaSections C R π a)) (b : Bool)
    44	    (s : relThetaSections C R π a) (hsK : s ∈ K)
    45	    (p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b))
    46	    (hspan : ∀ v : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[
    47	        Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    48	        (chartReadIdeal K b), ∃ c : p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
    49	          c • ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[
    50	            Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)]
    51	            (⟨relThetaResSide a b (le_rfl) s,
    52	              by
    53	                exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩⟩ :
    54	              chartReadIdeal K b)) = v) :
    55	    Subsingleton ((chartIdealColengthModule K b s) ⊗[
    56	      Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    57	  let B : Type u := Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
    58	  let I : Ideal B := Ideal.span {relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s}
    59	  let P : Submodule B B := chartReadIdeal K b
    60	  let f : B →ₗ[B] (B ⧸ I) := (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ B I).toLinearMap
    61	  have hsP : relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s ∈ P := by
    62	    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩
    63	  have hfs : f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0 := by
    64	    change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) = 0
    65	    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (by simp))
    66	  have hzero := RankOneFibre.subsingleton_map_tensor_of_span_singleton
    67	    P f (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl s) hsP (by
    68	      · intro v
    69	        exact hspan v) (by
    70	      · exact hfs)
    71	  change Subsingleton ((P.map f) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) at hzero
    72	  exact hzero

   262	      (relCurve C B).resHom _ ((relCurve C B).resHom _ _)

   265	  change (relCurve C B).resHom _ ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B _ (v : B)) =
   266	    a (v : B)

   346	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
   347	the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
   348	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   349	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   350	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   351	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   352	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   353	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   354	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   355	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   356	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   357	    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
   358	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   359	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   360	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   361	  let B := Localization.Away f
   362	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   363	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   364	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
   365	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
   366	  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
   367	  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
   368	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
   369	  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
   370	      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   371	    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
   372	    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
   373	        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
   374	      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   375	      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   376	    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]
   377	    rfl
   378	  calc
   379	    abelDivAffPlus C B F = PicEtAff.unit C B ((relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass) := rfl
   380	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C psi
   381	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]
   382	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi
   383	      (PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   384	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   385	      rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
   386	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi (PicEtAff.mapAlg C iota (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   387	      congr 1
   388	      rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]

    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.

    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules

    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf

    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),

   422	/-! ## Local-away generators for the canonical evaluation -/
   423	
   424	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the
   425	corresponding prime of the original ring to the residue field of a prime of `A_f`.
   426	
   427	The residue-field comparison is an isomorphism because localization induces bijective
   428	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   429	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/
   430	private theorem fibre_tmul_ne_zero_of_away
   431	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   432	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   433	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   434	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   435	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   436	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   437	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   438	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   439	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   440	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   441	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   442	    intro hf
   443	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   444	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   445	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   446	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   447	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   448	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   449	      (hy p hfp)
   450	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
   451	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   452	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   453	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   454	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   455	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom
   456	  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho :=
   457	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   458	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   459	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   460	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]

     7	/-!
     8	# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum
     9	
    10	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
    11	ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
    12	modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
    13	that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
    14	`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
    15	`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
    16	restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	The canonical piece trivializations also prove that the native module is a line
    19	bundle.  Pushforward base-change and existence of a tied
    20	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` remain genuine producer obligations.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    32	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    34	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
    35	
    36	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    41	
    42	/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.
    43	
    44	The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
    45	are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
    46	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    47	    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    48	      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
    49	  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    50	    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
    51	  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    52	      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    53	    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
    54	  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    55	    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    56	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    57	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    58	    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)
    59	
    60	/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
    62	  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    63	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
    64	  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    65	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    66	    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
    67	  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    68	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
    69	  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    70	    intro X Y f r m
    71	    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
    72	        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
    73	      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
    74	        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
    75	        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    76	    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    77	    apply Subtype.ext
    78	    funext j
    79	    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    80	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])
    81	
    82	/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
    83	noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
    84	  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
    85	  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    86	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
    87	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    88	    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    89	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    90	    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
    91	  all_goals rfl
    92	
    93	/-! ## Piecewise line-bundle trivializations -/
    94	
    95	/-- Sections of the native module over one cocycle piece are the structure-ring sections.
    96	
    97	The open-immersion ring equivalence transports the component trivialization from the ambient
    98	relative curve to the restricted scheme.  The `gluedTriv_gluedQsmul` identity is exactly the
    99	structure-sheaf semilinearity needed for this to be a linear equivalence over the restricted
   100	ring of sections. -/
   101	noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv
   102	    (j : D.index) (V : (D.pieces j).toScheme.Opens) :
   103	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) ≃ₗ[
   104	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) := by
   105	  let e := gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
   106	  let ρ := ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   107	  let f : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) →ₗ[
   108	      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) :=
   109	    { toFun := fun s => ρ (e s)
   110	      map_add' := by
   111	        intro s t
   112	        change ρ (e (s + t)) = ρ (e s) + ρ (e t)
   113	        change ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t)) =
   114	          ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s) +
   115	            ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t)
   116	        rw [show gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t) =
   117	            gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s +
   118	              gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t by
   119	              exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).map_add s t]
   120	        exact ρ.map_add _ _
   121	      map_smul' := by
   122	        intro r s
   123	        change ρ
   124	            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
   125	              (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl) (ρ.symm r) s)) =
   126	          r * ρ
   127	            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s)
   128	        rw [gluedTriv_gluedQsmul]
   129	        simp [ρ] }
   130	  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective f
   131	  constructor
   132	  · intro s t h
   133	    have h' := congrArg ρ.symm h
   134	    dsimp [f] at h'
   135	    rw [ρ.symm_apply_apply, ρ.symm_apply_apply] at h'
   136	    exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).injective h'
   137	  · intro r
   138	    refine ⟨e.symm (ρ.symm r), ?_⟩
   139	    change ρ (e (e.symm (ρ.symm r))) = r
   140	    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, ρ.apply_symm_apply]
   141	
   142	/-- The piecewise section equivalences assemble to a sheaf isomorphism with the unit module. -/
   143	noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSheafIso (j : D.index) :
   144	    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D) ≅
   145	      SheafOfModules.unit (D.pieces j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf :=
   146	  (SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _).preimageIso
   147	    (PresheafOfModules.isoMk
   148	      (fun V => (nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv D j V.unop).toModuleIso)
   149	      (fun {V W} f => by
   150	        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   151	        apply LinearMap.ext
   152	        intro x
   153	        change
   154	          ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso W.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   155	              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le W.unop)
   156	                (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
   157	                  ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop)) x)) =
   158	            (D.pieces j).toScheme.presheaf.map f
   159	              (((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   160	                (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x))
   161	        rw [gluedTriv_res B D.isGluingCocycle j
   162	          ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
   163	          ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x]
   164	        simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
   165	        change
   166	          (relCurve C B).resHom
   167	              ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
   168	              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
   169	                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x) =
   170	            (relCurve C B).presheaf.map
   171	              ((D.pieces j).ι.opensFunctor.map f.unop).op
   172	              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
   173	                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x)
   174	        rfl))
   175	
   176	/-- The canonical native module is locally a free rank-one structure-sheaf module. -/
   177	theorem nativeModule_isLineBundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle (nativeModule D) := by
   178	  intro x
   179	  let j := D.pieceIndex x
   180	  refine ⟨D.pieces j, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x, ?_⟩
   181	  exact ⟨nativeModulePieceSheafIso D j⟩
   182	
   183	/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
   184	the datum's original module of sections.
   185	
   186	The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
   187	point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
   188	of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
   189	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
   190	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
   191	    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   192	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
   193	      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
   194	  let f :
   195	      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   196	        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
   197	        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
   198	    { toFun := fun x => x
   199	      map_add' := by
   200	        intros
   201	        rfl
   202	      map_smul' := by
   203	        intro r x
   204	        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
   205	            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
   206	          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
   207	        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
   208	          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
   209	  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩
   210	
   211	/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.
   212	
   213	This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
   214	presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
   215	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
   216	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   217	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
   218	  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
   219	    (NatIso.ofComponents
   220	      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
   221	      (fun {_ _} _ => by
   222	        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   223	        apply LinearMap.ext
   224	        intro x
   225	        rfl))
   226	
   227	end
   228	
   229	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    97	
    98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
    99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   105	
   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   120	
   121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   128	
   129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   130	
   131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   132	
   133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens
   142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   152	
   153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   154	
   155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   158	
   159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   167	      φ.app S) D.sq
   168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   170	  · intro v w hvw
   171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   173	
   174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   175	
   176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   180	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   184	  intro X g
   185	  let d := D X g
   186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   187	
   188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   190	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   191	  h
   192	
   193	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   194	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   195	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   196	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   197	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   200	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   201	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   202	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   203	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   204	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   205	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   206	
   207	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   208	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   209	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   210	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   211	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   212	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   213	
   214	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   215	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   216	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   217	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   218	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   219	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   220	
   221	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   222	
   223	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   224	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   225	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   226	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   227	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   228	
   229	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   230	representer. -/
   231	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   232	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   233	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   234	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   235	
   236	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   237	def rankOneAbelAff :

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image

/-!
# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map

`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.

The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable section

/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.

Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
def PicRankOneOpen :
    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    rw [e]
    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

/-! ## The public membership contract -/

/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.

This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))

/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
contract. -/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
  rfl

/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h

/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h

/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
def picRankOneOpenIncl :
    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι

/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.

`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
relative-open gate below. -/
def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι

/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.

This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)

/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/

/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.

The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
  W : X.Opens
  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
    (w : S ⟶ X),
    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w

namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}

/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
      φ.app S) D.sq
  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
  · intro v w hvw
    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩

end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented

/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
  intro X g
  let d := D X g
  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩

/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
  h

/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
  h.property g fst snd hpb

/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h

/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h

/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.

This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))

/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
representer. -/
def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
def rankOneAbelAff :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))

/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom

/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
def rankOneAbelRepresented :
    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi

/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property

end

/-!
# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract

`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
explicit obligations.

The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

/-! ## The native adapter contract -/

/--
A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
cocycle datum.

The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
evaluation module.
-/
structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
  representative : descentClasses C cover
  represents :
    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
  datum_class :
    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
  native_pushforward_base_change :
    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
  h0_rank_one :
    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation

variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}

/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.

The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
without weakening or adding hypotheses.
-/
noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
  { cover := P.cover
    representative := P.representative
    represents := P.represents
    datum := P.datum
    datum_class := P.datum_class
    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }

theorem nonempty_localPresentation
    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩

end PicRankOneNativePresentation

/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/

/--
An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
-/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
  intro A _ _ t
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum

`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.

The canonical piece trivializations also prove that the native module is a line
bundle.  Pushforward base-change and existence of a tied
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` remain genuine producer obligations.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

noncomputable section

variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)

/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.

The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)

/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    intro X Y f r m
    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])

/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
  all_goals rfl

/-! ## Piecewise line-bundle trivializations -/

/-- Sections of the native module over one cocycle piece are the structure-ring sections.

The open-immersion ring equivalence transports the component trivialization from the ambient
relative curve to the restricted scheme.  The `gluedTriv_gluedQsmul` identity is exactly the
structure-sheaf semilinearity needed for this to be a linear equivalence over the restricted
ring of sections. -/
noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv
    (j : D.index) (V : (D.pieces j).toScheme.Opens) :
    Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) ≃ₗ[
      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) := by
  let e := gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
  let ρ := ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let f : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D), V) →ₗ[
      Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V)] Γ((D.pieces j).toScheme, V) :=
    { toFun := fun s => ρ (e s)
      map_add' := by
        intro s t
        change ρ (e (s + t)) = ρ (e s) + ρ (e t)
        change ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t)) =
          ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s) +
            ρ (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t)
        rw [show gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) (s + t) =
            gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s +
              gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) t by
              exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).map_add s t]
        exact ρ.map_add _ _
      map_smul' := by
        intro r s
        change ρ
            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)
              (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl) (ρ.symm r) s)) =
          r * ρ
            (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V) s)
        rw [gluedTriv_gluedQsmul]
        simp [ρ] }
  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective f
  constructor
  · intro s t h
    have h' := congrArg ρ.symm h
    dsimp [f] at h'
    rw [ρ.symm_apply_apply, ρ.symm_apply_apply] at h'
    exact (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V)).injective h'
  · intro r
    refine ⟨e.symm (ρ.symm r), ?_⟩
    change ρ (e (e.symm (ρ.symm r))) = r
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, ρ.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The piecewise section equivalences assemble to a sheaf isomorphism with the unit module. -/
noncomputable def nativeModulePieceSheafIso (j : D.index) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.pieces j).ι).obj (nativeModule D) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (D.pieces j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf :=
  (SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _).preimageIso
    (PresheafOfModules.isoMk
      (fun V => (nativeModulePieceSectionsEquiv D j V.unop).toModuleIso)
      (fun {V W} f => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        change
          ((D.pieces j).ι.appIso W.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le W.unop)
                (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
                  ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop)) x)) =
            (D.pieces j).toScheme.presheaf.map f
              (((D.pieces j).ι.appIso V.unop).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
                (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x))
        rw [gluedTriv_res B D.isGluingCocycle j
          ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
          ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x]
        simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
        change
          (relCurve C B).resHom
              ((D.pieces j).ι.image_mono (leOfHom f.unop))
              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x) =
            (relCurve C B).presheaf.map
              ((D.pieces j).ι.opensFunctor.map f.unop).op
              (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle j
                ((D.pieces j).ι_image_le V.unop) x)
        rfl))

/-- The canonical native module is locally a free rank-one structure-sheaf module. -/
theorem nativeModule_isLineBundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle (nativeModule D) := by
  intro x
  let j := D.pieceIndex x
  refine ⟨D.pieces j, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨nativeModulePieceSheafIso D j⟩

/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
the datum's original module of sections.

The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) := by
  let f :
      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
        (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) →ₗ[B]
        D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := by
        intros
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro r x
        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩

/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.

This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
    (NatIso.ofComponents
      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
      (fun {_ _} _ => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        rfl))

end

end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

end AlgebraicGeometry
